newsitem.title: TURKEY: HOECHST-TURK SABANCI IN POLYESTER YARN/CORD VENTUR.
newsitem.headline: HOECHST-TURK SABANCI IN POLYESTER YARN/CORD VENTUR.

text.p: Hoechst and Turkish industrial conglomerate Sabanci Holding will establish a 50-50 percent joint venture in Turkey to produce polyester yarn and polyester cord, Sabanci Holding said in a statement.
It said the company to be named HoechstSA, will set up a plant in Izmit, 100 kilometres to the east of Istanbul where several Sabanci group firms have factories.
Ninety percent of Hoechst SA's output will be exported.

The details of the joint venture will be introduced by Justus Mische, vice president of Hoechst and Sakip Sabanci, president of Sabanci Holding, at a press meeting to be held in Istanbul on Wednesday.
